title: Sol productivity app
summary: The goal was to create a modern, elegant, and user-friendly productivity application that streamlines task management and team alignment, providing a distraction-free digital workspace.
challenge: Modern professionals are overwhelmed by cluttered task boards and scattered communication channels. The primary hurdle was designing an interface that delivers powerful prioritization features while maintaining an ultra-clean, minimal aesthetic that reduces cognitive load.
outcome: A cohesive design system and interactive web experience that increased daily active retention by 42% and earned praise across design communities for its fluid ergonomics and intuitive keyboard navigation.

title: Amin SaaS Landing
summary: Designed and built a high-converting landing page showcasing AI-driven automation workflows with interactive component demos and conversion-optimized sales funnels.
challenge: Articulating complex artificial intelligence data pipelines to non-technical business founders without relying on confusing technical jargon or generic stock tech diagrams.
outcome: Conversion rate from landing visitor to free trial signup increased by 68% within the first 30 days post-launch, driving over $1.2M in seed pipeline.

title: Finova Dashboard
summary: Architected an end-to-end multi-currency financial analytics dashboard with customizable modular data widgets and real-time transaction reporting.
challenge: Dense financial balance sheets and global remittance feeds required meticulous typography hierarchies, contrast compliance, and instant scanning readability under high-stress trading scenarios.
outcome: Reduced average operator task completion duration by 35% and established a multi-theme design system now adopted across Finova's web and mobile applications.

title: MedX startup brand
summary: Created an approachable yet trustworthy visual identity and digital web experience for a telemedicine healthcare provider bridging patient care and automated diagnostics.
challenge: Balancing sterile medical credibility with warm human reassurance, ensuring patients of all demographics could easily navigate remote consultations and prescription renewals.
outcome: Successfully launched MedX into 8 regional markets, onboarding over 25,000 patients with a 4.9/5 patient satisfaction score.

title: E-commerce Redesign
summary: Revitalized the digital flagship experience for an avant-garde apparel label, integrating bespoke motion design, tactile micro-interactions, and a frictionless checkout flow.
challenge: High cart abandonment rates on mobile devices caused by slow page transitions, disjointed sizing charts, and cumbersome multi-step payment screens.
outcome: Mobile checkout conversions leaped by 53%, average session time doubled, and the redesign was nominated for Site of the Day on Awwwards.
